tei:div.tei:p: (99)ma gcig snyan brgyud chen mo las/ lus sbyin yum chen zhal lung bzhugs/ (100)

na mo gu ru pradz+nyā mi ta ye/ rnal 'byor pas 'khor ba blos btang zhing ri khrod 'grim nus pa gcig gis phung po'i 'jin pa bor nas tshogs bsags pa las/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs sogs dang*/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig sogs brjod/ phaṭaḥ rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'khrig pa'i klong*/ pad+ma nyi ma bam gyi gdan steng su/ ma gcig lab sgron zla ba rgyas pa'i mdog g.yas pas ḍā ru nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khrol/ g.yon pas dngul dkar dril bu sil sil sgrogs/ sku la dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan/ dbu skra sil mas sku rgyab kheb pa yi/ spyi gtsug phag zhal nag mos ngur sgra sgrogs/ de yi thugs kar 'od kyi drwa ba'i klong*/ rgyal ba'i bskyed yum shes rab pha rol phyin/ (101)zhal gcig phyag bzhi btso ma gser gyi mdog g.yas kyi dang pos gser gyi rdo rje 'jin/ g.yon gyi dang pos phar phyin glegs bam 'jin/ 'og ma gnyis kyi mnyam bzhag phyag rgya mjad/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas kyi rnam par rol/ ma gcig spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*/ rigs kyi bdag po dam pa sangs rgyas ni/ dmar smug brjid pa zhi ma khro yi nyams/ spyan gsum lta stangs nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs/ rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rol pas brgyan/ phyag gnyis lte 'og ting 'jin phyag rgya mjad/ mtha' skor grub thob gcod yul brgyud pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi dang khro bos bskor/ ma gcig phyogs bzhir pad+mam bam gyi steng*/ rdo rje rin chen pad+ma karma yi/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi mthing (102)seradamar ljang mdog gri gug thod 'jin dar sangs rgyas rus pas brgyan/ kun kyang mkha' la thogs med phyag rgya bsgyur/ 'khor du gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ yul chen so gnyis dur khrod chen po brgyad/ dpal gyi rol pa he ru'i gnas bcu na/

bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ bka' sdod ye shes 'jig rten dregs pas bskor/ gnas gsum yi ge 'od 'phros 'og min nas/ ye shes pa rnams char bzhin thibs nas byon/ phaṭaḥ gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ yum chen mo pha rol phyin ma la/ sras 'phags pa bzhi yi 'khor dang bcas/ gnas 'di ru spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ pha grub thob dam pa sangs rgyas la/ mgon grub thob gcod yul brgyud pa dang*/ lha yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho bcas/ gnas 'di ru spyan (103)'dren gshegs su gsaul/ gnas o rgyan rang byung zhing khams na/ ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ma gcig ma/ 'khor gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ gsungs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho bcas/ gnas 'di ru spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ oṃ gu ru de ba ḍāk+ki ni ha ri ni sa ma ya jaḥjaḥ phaṭaḥ pad+ma nyi ma bam gyi gdan/ phyag dang zhabs gnyis bsil mjad la/ rnal 'byor bdag la byin rlobs phyir/ dgyes pa chen pos bzhugs su gsol/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ phaṭaḥ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du/ lus ni de snyed rnam bsam zhing*/ bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho bcas/ yum chen 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal/ phaṭaḥ chu bo gaṅga'i rgyun bzhin du/ mchod yon ji snyed yod pa (104)kun/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ ma dros rgya mtsho'i mjing bzhin du/ yan lag brgyad ldan zhabs bsil rigs/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ stong gsum lha mi'i 'jig rten na/ me tog sna tshogs mjes pa'i rigs/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ rang byung lhan skyes sbyar ba'i spos/ dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin tshogs 'di/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ nyi ma zla ba rin po che/ mun pa 'joms byed snang ba'i tshogs/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ tsan+dan ga bur bsil ba'i tshogs/ chu dang sbyar ba'i dri chab 'di/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bza' bca' btung ba mchog gi ro/

lha mi'i zhal zas ji snyed kun/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ pi (105)waṃ gling bu rnga dung sgra/ rgyud mang rol mo'i bye brag rnams/ ma yum chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sargyaṃ saugs/ ma skyes ma 'gags chos sku pha rol phyin/ skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ sgo gsum gus pa chen pos bstod par bgyi/ ma gcig gi thug kar yum chen mo gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma zla ba'i steng du skye ba med pa'i yi ge āḥdakar po'i mtha' bskor du oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ni baṃ ha ri ni sa tsirta hriṃ hriṃ jaḥjaḥ tad+ya thā/ de nas bem po tshogs kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ phaṭaḥ rang lus tshe tshe bkrag mdangs ldan pa'i dbus/ dbu ma ye shes stong gsal ye shes lam/ mar sne lte 'og phag rtugs zum pa yi/ yar sne tshangs pa'i sgo nas har gris phyes/ (106)snying gi thad du thig le sngon po'i steng*/ rlung sems 'dus pa'i ngo bo khros ma'i sku/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rus rgyan gar stabs can/ g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas thod pa 'jin/ rna ltag phag zhal nag mos ngur sgra sgrogs/ rje mthor 'phar nas tshangs pa'i lam nas thon/ chos nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyang kyis thon/ g.yas pas gri gug bem po'i thod pa breg rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i snod/ ri rab dang mnyam thod pa'i sgyed pur bzhag nang du sha khrag sil bur gtub ste blug ngag nas 'bru gsum brjod pa'i 'od zer gyis/ 'og nas rlung g.yos me sbar bdud rtsi khol/ steng nas haṃ yig ye shes bdud rtsir zhu/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags gang 'dod kyis/ kha dog dri ro nus pa dpag med spel/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phaṭaḥ (107)gnas spros pa bral ba'i pho brang nas/ ma rgyal ba'i yum chen phar phyin ma/ sras phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ lam 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal tshogs/

gnas 'di ru tshogs la gshegs su gsol/ ma yum chen 'khor bcas byon pa'i tshe/ sku mtshan dpe gar stabs shigs se shig gsung chos nyid rang sgra 'u ru ru/ thugs mkhyen brtse dgongs pa lams se lam/ lus bem po'i bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes/ thugs zag med bde bas dgyes par rol/ bu'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ lus bem po'i gdon dang da phrol cig sems bdag 'jin 'di dang da phrol cig las nad gdon 'di dang da phrol cig chos stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i don/ yum pha rol phyin pa'i rang (108)zhal ston/ phaṭaḥ gnas rang snang rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ pha grub thob dam pa sangs rgyas la/ 'khor rgyud gsum rig 'jin bla ma la/ ma yi dam khros ma rigs lnga dang*/ dpal zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams/ gnas 'di ru tshogs la gshegs su gsol/ pha grub thob rgya mtsho byon pa'i tshe/ sku brtul zhugs rol pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/ gsung chos nyid hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs/ thugs bde stong nyams 'bar ya la la/ chos gzung 'jin snang ba khral ma khrol/ lus bem po'i bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes/ thugs zag med bde bas dgyes par rol/ bu'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ lus bem po'i gdon dang da phrol cig sems bdag 'jin 'di dang phrol cig las nad gdon 'di dang da phrol cig chos stong nyid (109)phyag rgya chen po'i don/ yum pha rol phyin ma'i rang zhal ston/ phaṭaḥ gnas o rgyan rang byung mkha' spyod zhing*/ yul mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog 'og min zhing*/ rang snang ba rnam dag zhing khams nas/ ma lab kyi sgron ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ 'khor ye shes mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i grong khyer na/ bzhugs pa yi dpa' ba mkha' 'gro rnams/ gnas 'di ru bem po'i tshogs la gshegs/ ma lab sgron 'khor bcas byon pa'i tshe/ dbyings nam mkhar 'ja' tshon lams se lam/ rgyan dar dpyang rus rgyan su ru ru/

sku mjes pa'i goms stabs shigs se shig gsung phaṭa dang phem sgra 'u ru ru/ thugs bde chen nyams 'bar ya la la/ rnga cang til (110)g.yer kha khro lo lo/ lus bem po'i bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes/ thugs zag med bde bas dgyes par rol/ bu'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ lus bem po'i gdon dang phrol cig sems bdag 'jin 'di dang phrol cig las nad gdon 'di da phrol cig chos stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i don/ yum pha rol phyin pa'i rang zhal ston/ phaṭaḥ yul chen po sum cu po gnyis dang*/ dpal he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ yul 'jam bu gling gi dur khrod brgyad/ sems nyams dga' skyong ba'i gnas gzhi dang*/ lam spyod pa spyod pa'i gnas drug na/ ma sems can don la bzhugs pa yi/ ma mkha' 'gro dpa' bo rgya mtsho rnams/ gnas 'di ru bem po'i tshogs la gshegs/ khyed dpa' bo mkha' 'gro byon pa'i tshe/ dbyings nam mkhar 'ja' tshon lams (111)se lam/ rgyan dar dpyang rus rgyan su ru ru/ sku mjes pa'i gom stabs shigs se shig gsung phaṭa dang phem sgra 'u ru ru/ thugs bde chen nyams dga' ya la la/ rnga cang til g.yer kha khro lo lo/ lus bem po'i bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes/ thugs zag med bde bas dgyer par rol/ bu'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ lus bem po'i gdon dang da phrol cig sems bdag 'jin 'di dang phrol cig las nad gdon 'di dang da phrol cig chos stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i don/ yum pha rol phyin pa'i rang zhal ston/ phaṭaḥ mgon drag po ma hā kā la la/ chos skyong ba'i dpal mgon bdun cu dang*/ bde gangs ri phreng ba'i gzhi bdag bskor/ gnas 'di ru bem po'i tshogs la gshegs/ dpal (112)dam can rgya mtsho byon pa'i tshe/ gnas 'jin rten khams kun shigs se shig ri rgya mtsho 'jin ma 'gul snyams bgyid/ sprin rlung nag 'tshubs ma 'u ru ru/ 'od glog dmar zhags pa khyugs se khyug

mtshon gnam lcags skyin mda' sha ra ra/ sgra ki bswo cha sgra di di ri/ dpal srung ma'i dmag tshogs nyi li li/ go mtshon cha'i bkrag mdangs ya la la/ lus bem po'i bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes/ thugs gang 'dod longs spyod mi zad pa'i/ ci 'dod pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ chos byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sol/ dgra gzugs can gzugs med thal bar rlog lus bem po'i gdon dang da phrol cig sems bdag 'jin 'di dang da phrol cig las nad gdon 'di dang da phrol cig bdag rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i sdong (113)grogs mjod/ phaṭaḥ mgron gtso bo tshangs pa gdong bzhi la/ ma rigs drug sems can mgron gyi bskor/ lus bem pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa rol/ zas phun tshogs dar zab gos kyi rigs/ nor rin chen rta dang glang po gnags/ yul skyed mos tshal dang khang bzang sogs/ yid ci 'dod longs spyod zad med par/ sems phab rgyal che chung med par bsngo/ don bsngos pa bzhin du thob gyur cig tshe snga ma'i lan chags 'khor nas kyang*/ dus da lta'i mkhon sems zhi gyur cig ma 'gro ba rigs drug sems can gyis/ las so so'i sdug bsngal bral bar shog phaṭaḥbagegs rgyal po bi na ya ga la/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad dang*/ 'og rlung gi 'khor lo yan chad la/ rten bcas (114)pa'i sde brgyad mi ma yin/ khyod ma lus 'khor bcas bran dang bcas/ gnas 'di ru myur du sleb par gyis/ lus bam chen bdud rtsi'i bcud la rol/ gtso bran g.yog 'khor bcas tshim gyur cig phaṭaḥ lus bem shun shugs kyi ral ba las/ gzhi stong gsum khyab pa'i zhing lpags steng*/ sha bza' ba'i phung po ri ltar spungs/ khrag btung ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab/ rus sla ba'i phung po ri ltar brdal/ khyed sha dang khrag la dga' ba rnams/ lus mi rtag sgyu ma'i phung po 'di/ ngas cis kyang mi bzhag 'dor ba la/ 'dre khyed rnams dgos na su dgos khyer/ sha ri yi phung po'i rtse nas ze/

khrag btung ba'i rgya mtsho'i gting nas 'thung*/ rus rkang rdung sla ba dang bcas zo/ phud lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol/ 'dre (115)khyed rnams yid la gang 'dod du/ gzugs phung po'i mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas/ sems bsngos pa bzhin du tshim gyur cig gdon snang srid lha 'dre sde brgyad rnams/ sems gzhanya la gnod pa'i bsam ngan zhing*/ rgyud byang chub sems kyi rlan nas kyang*/ lus bem po'i gdon dang da khrol cig sems bdag 'jin 'di dang da phrol cig las nad gdon 'di dang da phrol cig chos phyag rgya chen sgom pa la/ 'dre khyed rnams phrag dog ma byed par/ lam rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs mjod/ ces chos sbyin bde sdug gtong len byed/ mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ces pa 'di ni ma gcig dang dam pa rgya gar gnyis kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing zab mo gcod kyi gdam pa rjogs par gnang zhing srung ma rnams (116) kyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i mna' bor/ rang gi yid la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa shar ba'i tshe/ ma gcig gis byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pas snyan brgyud chen po'i gzhung nas tshig sna tshig sna bsdus te cung zad bkod pa'o/// /
